title: Stepper
api:
interface StepperItem {
  id: string
  label: string
  description?: string
  content?: ReactNode
  disabled?: boolean
  error?: boolean
}

interface StepperProps extends Omit<
  HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>,
  'children' | 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'
> {
  items: readonly StepperItem[]
  /** Zero-based index. items.length represents the completed sequence. */
  value?: number
  defaultValue?: number
  onValueChange?: (value: number) => void
  /** Future steps stay unavailable until the host form validates and advances. */
  allowNextStepsSelect?: boolean
  allowStepSelect?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  completedContent?: ReactNode
}

function normalizeStepperValue(value: number, count: number);
function canSelectStep(
  index: number,
  active: number,
  count: number,
  options: {
    disabled?: boolean
    itemDisabled?: boolean
    allowStepSelect?: boolean
    allowNextStepsSelect?: boolean
  } = {},
);
function Stepper({
  items,
  value,
  defaultValue = 0,
  onValueChange,
  allowNextStepsSelect = false,
  allowStepSelect = true,
  disabled,
  orientation = 'horizontal',
  size = 'md',
  completedContent,
  className,
  'aria-label': labelProp,
  ...props
}: StepperProps);

props.name: value
props.description: Zero-based index. items.length represents the completed sequence.

props.name: allowNextStepsSelect
props.description: Future steps stay unavailable until the host form validates and advances.
